analysis:
Only changelog fragments and docs/architecture/hardware-support.md were supplied. No executable source changed in the supplied units, so no concrete regression can be cited. The text describes behavior in code that was not provided, and I treat it as unverified claims.

Threat-model-relevant claims the next pass should check against the code:
- changelog.d/glm53-video-input.md:3 adds inline video_url decoding of consumer-supplied data on the provider. T-050 covers inline-video plaintext in provider temp files. The changelog does not say whether the new decode path avoids FileManager temp files. Check that, and the decoder's bounds (512 MiB frame cap, 28,532-token cap).
- changelog.d/glm53-native-prerequisites.md:9 and :21 say the GLM prefix cache is default-on via the SSD tier, with media rows never reusing cached prefixes. That falls under T-041 / SEC-035. Line 21 says DEBUG builds can load a persistent cache key from DARKBLOOM_DEBUG_CACHE_KEY_FILE, and release builds do not contain that path. Verify that the path is compiled out of release builds and that the key file's 0600 mode and ownership are enforced.
- changelog.d/glm53-native-prerequisites.md:14 adds the new capability glm5_next_v1, the catalog model glm-5.3-flash, and a requirement that the catalog entry, revision receipt and loaded bytes agree on one aggregate. This touches TB-002 and TB-009 and A-004/T-012 (weight integrity). Verify the capability claim and hash binding in code. Line 23 changes weight hashing to F_NOCACHE aligned reads. The digests are claimed unchanged, but hashing before and after the load leaves a TOCTOU window if the operator can swap files.
- changelog.d/local-responses-continuation.md:3-4 and hardware-support.md:35-42 add local-mode retention of plaintext response and continuation history in memory. The SDK response store is described as having no eviction. This is local direct mode only. It concerns A-001 retention and memory growth. Confirm that it is not reachable in coordinator-connected mode.
- changelog.d/glm53-native-prerequisites.md:8,16 describe retained-fault metrics and fail-closed retirement for GLM. Confirm that these availability controls match the code and do not expose sensitive data on local /metrics.
- hardware-support.md only adds docs. It cites the GLM5Next load admission, the MiMo prompt recount, and MTP request-generation binding. No source was visible to verify them.
